notes: Read all 170 numbered source lines before editing. This is the standalone reusable WidgetShell (not a per-widget inline subset), so every prop and dependency is ported native-safe with React Native primitives + the shared apps/native AppText component and theme/tokens, matching the established widget-port idiom (AutomationHistoryWidget/GuardModeWidget).

L1 react imports {type ReactNode,useState,useEffect,useRef} -> kept (React added for JSX). L2 @/lib/cn -> dropped; StyleSheet arrays compose styles instead, with every Tailwind utility string translated to flex/spacing/colour equivalents.

L3 feedback {Skeleton,QueryError} -> inline Skeleton (flex-1 rounded surface block, testID widget-shell-skeleton) + inline WidgetQueryError. WidgetShell only ever feeds QueryError `new Error(error)` (a plain Error, never an ApiError) with no onRetry, and native has no navigator.onLine, so QueryError's transient/404/401-403/5xx/offline branches are unreachable; the realised output is the generic network ErrorState (rose card + AlertCircle glyph + error.network.title "Can't reach server" + error.network.message), reproduced verbatim. Web never renders the raw error string for a plain Error, so neither does the port (asserted in the test).

L4 ui {HelpTooltip,PinButton} -> inline HelpTooltip + PinButton. HelpTooltip keeps the same text resolution (i18nKey?defaultValue:text; renders nothing when empty); the hover/focus floating Tooltip has no touch analogue so the '?' trigger toggles an inline disclosure bubble on press, and learnMore opens via Linking.openURL (web opened a new tab). PinButton is wired to the REAL native usePinned/useTogglePin hooks (../../../api/hooks/usePinned) so it keeps the /pinned API path, PinnedItemType, isPinned lookup, and toggle.mutate({itemId,context,pin}) contract; lucide Pin/PinOff + the wrapping Tooltip collapse to a PIN/PINNED token (amber when pinned, muted otherwise) with the label on accessibilityLabel.

L5-9 data-display {DataFreshness,DataFreshnessAuto,type FreshnessQuery} -> inline DataFreshness + DataFreshnessAuto + re-exported FreshnessQuery = Pick<UseQueryResult<unknown,unknown>,'isFetching'|'isStale'|'isError'|'dataUpdatedAt'|'refetch'> (verbatim, @tanstack/react-query is a native dep). DataFreshness keeps isError>fetching>stale>fresh precedence, dot tiers #34d399/#38bdf8/#fbbf24/#f87171, the 'just now / Nm/Nh/Nd/Nw ago' + 'updating\u2026'/'error' ladder, the 30s tick (active only while updatedAt is truthy, cleaned up on unmount), onRefresh on a role=button Pressable, and compact (dot-only) mode. lucide Wifi/WifiOff/RefreshCw and the reduced-motion ping/spin/pulse animations are dropped (RN has no CSS animation); the dot colour carries the status. DataFreshnessAuto keeps the forceStaleAfterMs override + dataUpdatedAt>0?:null + refetchable default-true wiring.
L10 ./types WidgetHelp -> re-declared WidgetHelp interface (text?/i18nKey?/defaultValue?/learnMore{url,label?}); no native widget types module exists yet so it is exported from this file.

L12-51 WidgetShellProps -> exported verbatim with every prop (title,icon,loading,error,children,noPadding,actions,query,updatedAt,isFetching,isStale,isError,onRefresh,help,widgetId,dashboardId) and all JSDoc comments preserved; ReactNode stays ReactNode.

L53-58 destructure preserved verbatim. L59-61 justUpdated useState + prevUpdatedAt useRef preserved. L63-65 effectiveUpdatedAt = updatedAt ?? query?.dataUpdatedAt preserved. L67-80 pulse useEffect (timestamp-change -> setJustUpdated(true) for 1500ms, prevUpdatedAt bookkeeping, clearTimeout cleanup) ported byte-for-byte.

L82 loading -> <Skeleton/> (web Skeleton className h-full rounded-xl). L83-87 error -> centered errorWrap View wrapping WidgetQueryError (web h-full flex items-center justify-center p-4 around <QueryError error={new Error(error)} />).

L89 showFreshness = updatedAt!==undefined || query!==undefined preserved. L90-91 freshnessCompact = !title preserved. L93-111 freshnessEl resolution preserved: updatedAt!==undefined branch builds DataFreshness (updatedAt>0?:null, isFetching/isStale/isError ?? false, onRefresh, compact) else query branch builds DataFreshnessAuto(query,compact).

L113-119 root container: web `relative h-full flex flex-col transition-shadow` -> View styles.shell (flex:1; column is RN default; position:relative is implicit; transition is a no-op in RN). justUpdated -> styles.shellPulse green glow shadow rgba(34,197,94,0.15) radius 12 (web shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(34,197,94,0.15)]).

L120-149 title header branch: flex-shrink-0 row space-between px-4 pt-3 pb-1 -> styles.header; left titleGroup (gap-1.5) renders {icon} + uppercase 11px tracking-wider text-muted title (AppText, accessibilityRole header, numberOfLines 1) + HelpTooltip when help (size xs, ariaLabel `More info about ${title}` template preserved). Right headerRight (gap-2) renders freshnessEl + PinButton when widgetId&&dashboardId (itemType 'widget', context dashboardId) + {actions}.

L150-164 title-less branch (<>): freshnessEl floated in styles.freshnessOverlay (absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 z-[5]) and actions in styles.actionsRow (flex-shrink-0 justify-end px-4 pt-3 pb-1) when present.

L165-167 body: web `@container flex-1 min-h-0` + (noPadding?'overflow-hidden':'px-4 pb-3 overflow-auto') -> styles.body flex:1 with bodyPadded (px-4 pb-3) or bodyNoPadding (overflow hidden). The @container query context and overflow-auto scroll have no RN equivalent; scrolling is delegated to the widget children (matching the repo inline-shell idiom) to avoid nested VirtualizedList. {children} rendered. L168-170 close + named `export function WidgetShell` (web has no default export).

react-i18next useTranslation -> inline English-default t with {{var}} interpolation, preserving every key: freshness.justNow/minutes/hours/days/weeks/updating/error/refresh, a11y.dataFreshness, error.network.title/message, help.tooltip.iconLabel, common.learnMore, pin.pin/unpin/pinned.

Gates run from apps/native and all green: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint .) exit 0 (the new file is 0-warning after removing two no-void operators); npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles all suites pass with no open handles. Companion __tests__/WidgetShellParity.test.tsx (14 tests) covers loading skeleton, generic network error (raw string not shown), title header + body, updatedAt relative label, updating-while-fetching, onRefresh press, query-driven DataFreshnessAuto + refetch press, error freshness dot, help reveal-on-press, pin toggle via mocked useTogglePin, compact title-less overlay (dot-only), title-less action row, noPadding body, and the timestamp-change pulse path; every test unmounts so the 30s freshness interval leaves no open handle. No DOM, react-router, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.
